screen_rule: Published pool requires difficulty level 4 or 5; all prior level 1-3 questions removed from active pool. The 105-item averages family was additionally archived because its current items are one-step mean-plus-offset templates and fail the required reasoning-depth standard even though labeled level 4.
gold_standard_reference: gold_standard_25.json: all reference items are level 4 or 5; rubric emphasizes multi-step inference, competing hypotheses, interacting constraints, close distractors, and working-memory load.
limitations: This is an automated/conservative level screen, not a human judgment of every semantic item. It does not claim that every retained question is equivalent to a real Ministry exam item.
